g2_replay_order_balance_check.finding: order does not explain the clustering. With arms alternated by the Task's own frozen arm_order the split stayed BASE 0 / PATCHED 3, and by position it was first 1 / second 2. Across three replays it is PATCHED 8 / BASE 0.
g2_replay_order_balance_check.replication: the behavioural result replicated exactly: 6 comparable pairs, 5 changed, the same five Task ids, and outlier_mad again proposed first at the Context the active clause authorizes

weather_utility_ruling.retained: behavioural and mechanical evidence stands: the Agent inspected named scoped series, the Runtime compiled and executed Typed Programs, Episodes and Target-local Skills formed, attribution and the Slow single-surface route ran, and the paired replay changed next-round behaviour
weather_utility_ruling.unavailable: every aggregate utility conclusion on Weather, positive or negative, is UNAVAILABLE / METRIC_UNREADABLE
weather_utility_ruling.reason: macro_gain is an unweighted mean over eval channels whose identity losses span 24.4x. Three solar-radiation channels the forecaster cannot predict at all (sMASE about 17, where 1.0 is seasonal-naive parity) carry the aggregate, while the two channels it does forecast well both get worse under the same Program. T233 spans 2.0x and reads cleanly, so this is a property of the Weather cohort, not of the Judge in general.
constraints: Weather is never again called fresh
Weather is disqualified as the G3 cohort

P3.why_not_a_pass: the run still contained four mechanical exits, each of which truncates an arm-Task before it can spend its tool budget. The drop is therefore not attributable to the prompt repair, and it is not written as a PASS. It is also not evidence the repair suppressed tool use.

source_card_ruling.ruling: unmatched Source Cards stay out of the Agent's Context
detail: a Source Card that does not match the Task Context is kept in the audit record only; it never enters the Agent prompt and never acts as a template that could shape a proposal

only a genuinely matching Card enters the Card channel

source_card_ruling.implementation_status: already the implemented behaviour: _source_prior_for_task returns None on a non-match and the runner passes None, so no Card field, workflow name or operator name reaches a non-matching Task.
